stem.text: The equation for the formation of ammonium chloride is shown.
Which diagram shows the correctly labelled reaction pathway diagram for the decomposition of ammonium chloride?

A.alt: Energy profile: NH4Cl at low energy; EA arrow from the NH3 + HCl level up to the peak; ΔH arrow from the NH4Cl level up to the NH3 + HCl level.

B.alt: Energy profile: NH4Cl at low energy; EA arrow from the NH4Cl level up to the peak; ΔH arrow from the NH4Cl level up to the higher NH3 + HCl level.

C.alt: Energy profile: NH4Cl at higher energy; EA arrow from the NH4Cl level up to the peak; then falls to a lower NH3 + HCl level; ΔH arrow pointing down from the NH4Cl level to the NH3 + HCl level.

D.alt: Energy profile: NH4Cl at higher energy; EA arrow from the NH3 + HCl level up to a peak; then falls to a lower NH3 + HCl level; ΔH arrow pointing down from the NH4Cl level to the NH3 + HCl level.
